summary: Tested Time Traveler's Dilemma MVP. Backend GET /eras, /items and POST /judge validation work. Frontend Home -> Picker -> Action flow works end-to-end (era cards, locked tap blocked, item select, enter button, plan input + counter, history screen). BLOCKER: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget is exhausted ('Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.004473, Max budget: 0.001'), so POST /api/judge fails with 502 and the verdict screen / history population cannot be exercised.

critical.issue: LLM call fails with litellm.BadRequestError: 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.004473, Max budget: 0.001'. Backend returns 502 'Time stream unstable'. Root cause is the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env has a hard $0.001 budget cap that is already over. This blocks the entire happy path (no game records can be created, so /games, /stats, DELETE all observe empty data).

minor.issue: Pydantic model JudgeRequest allows plan up to 600 chars, but frontend action.tsx hard-caps at MAX=300. Either align constants or expose MAX to the UI from one source.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be fully verified because backend /api/judge currently 502s due to LLM key budget. UI will show 'The time stream is unstable. Try again.' error toast (verified path exists in action.tsx).

issues: Several 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' console warnings - not user-facing but worth migrating styles (theme uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius on cellSelected etc.).
TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated warning. Consider Pressable.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses pointerEvents prop on <View>; React Native Web warns props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents. Cosmetic warning only.

action_items: CRITICAL: Refresh/raise the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget or provision a new key. The current key in /app/backend/.env returns LiteLLM BudgetExceeded. Without it the entire AI judgment flow is broken (502).
Decide canonical max plan length - backend allows 600, frontend caps at 300. Recommend matching to 300 on both or 600 on both.
Optional: migrate shadow* props to boxShadow on web target, swap TouchableWithoutFeedback for Pressable, move pointerEvents to style to silence deprecation warnings.
After LLM key is fixed, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_ttd_api.py to verify TestJudge.test_judge_happy_path and the games/stats/delete suite pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/games and /api/stats correctly exclude mongo _id via projection {_id:0}. /api/judge response uses JudgeResponse model so no _id leak. Good.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via /app/frontend/.env - consistent with Expo public env var conventions.
GameProvider context state is reset on home mount which is correct. Picker and Action guard against missing era/item by redirecting to / - good.
Backend uses HTTPException 400 for invalid era/item ids (verified).

success_rate.backend: 50% (4/8 - all non-LLM endpoints pass; 4 failures all caused by single LLM budget issue)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (Home, Picker, Action, History screens render and navigate; verdict screen blocked by backend LLM failure)

seed_data_creation: None (tests use ephemeral TEST_<uuid> device_id and clean up after themselves).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs -d '\n') && pytest /app/backend/tests/test_ttd_api.py -v`. The four currently-failing tests will go green automatically once EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget is fixed. For UI re-verification, run a fresh playwright session: Home -> tap era-card-roman -> tap item-card-compass -> enter-time-stream -> type plan -> submit-plan -> wait 10-15s for verdict screen with verdict-badge / score-meter -> tap view-logs -> assert history row appears -> history-clear should now be visible.
rca_of_issue: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY sk-emergent-7B778234b60D23f52A is throttled by upstream LiteLLM proxy with a per-key budget of $0.001 which is already exceeded. Backend correctly surfaces this as HTTP 502 'Time stream unstable: ... Budget has been exceeded'. Reproduction: `curl -X POST $EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/api/judge -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"device_id":"x","era_id":"moon","item_id":"compass","plan":"test"}'`. Mitigation: replace/extend the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env, then `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. No code change needed.
